Recorded semiconductor premarket weakness was broad. Monday’s opening rebounds often faded; the notes do not establish a single-company demand collapse.
9/10 names have negative completed-bar VEL5. QCOM’s +1.2 is a fragile zero-crossing, while its source still labels the gate SELLING.
TSM and AMD retain the strongest selected quarterly/annual constructive cases, conditional on accepted shipments, margins and per-share cash returns; neither is a tactical buy call.
ARM carries unresolved contract remedies and weak relative strength. NET pairs the deepest negative velocity with reliability and monetization questions.
MU’s reported October 22 labor plan is not a verified outage. ARM/QCOM’s scheduled October 20 legal closings are not a ruling; no after-cutoff result is inferred.
